description: Build a daemon that runs every 1800s and updates mcp_server_registry.verdict by aggregating mcp_signal_scores across the 7 trust framework signals using the documented weights. Pure read of signal_scores, single UPDATE statement to registry per row. Uses ws_write for the UPDATE. Skips rows where verdict was UPDATEd in the last 6 hours. Emits a verdict_aggregation mesh_event per cycle with counts. This is the verdict_assigner carryover from PROJECT_GOALS.md, distinct from the archived decision_emitter.
